original_model.name: USD Impact Score v2
original_model.historical_comparison: 617 weeks in prior provenance; no values fetched in this feasibility

decision.reason: Named ICE/S&P/Cboe/CME/BTC USD price sources have no established zero-cost commercial derived/public rights, while government candidates change market semantics, frequency or data timing.

drivers.legacy_source: Yahoo delivery; ICE U.S. Dollar Index

candidates.cadence: daily observations; previous week's values released Monday ~16:15 ET
candidates.commercial_rights_evidence: Board site generally public domain except flagged third-party; source-specific currency/index rights must be verified
candidates.notes: Weights/index methodology revised; not ICE DXY. Board DDP build-your-package scheduled for retirement, direct endpoint continuity unverified. Same-week Friday cannot use following Monday release.

candidates.cadence: daily, Monday publication of prior week
candidates.commercial_rights_evidence: Board general public-domain disclaimer with flagged-source caveat
candidates.notes: AFE subindex also not ICE six-currency DXY; do not blend/proxy without separate model and owner approval.

drivers.legacy_semantics: rolling crude futures continuous front contract

candidates.provider: EIA published spot assessments; underlying Refinitiv historical prices
candidates.cadence: daily observed; weekly EIA published update with lag
candidates.commercial_rights_evidence: EIA disclosed historical WTI/Brent spot time series purchased from Refinitiv and republished with permission; downstream license unresolved
candidates.notes: General EIA public-domain statement alone does not establish downstream redistribution/retention of privately licensed market assessments; basis, roll, settlement and lag differ.

candidates.provider: EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report; U.S. commercial crude oil stocks excluding SPR
candidates.cadence: weekly Friday reference; following Wednesday ~10:30 ET release
candidates.commercial_rights_evidence: EIA government survey/statistical output subject to EIA reuse policy; verify exact series and third-party exemptions
candidates.notes: Measures physical inventories, not market WTI; would require newly reviewed sign/normalization and lag.

drivers.legacy_source: Yahoo delivery; S&P Dow Jones Indices

candidates.provider: Bureau of Economic Analysis corporate profits
candidates.commercial_rights_evidence: Official federal economic-statistics release; exact reuse/third-party notes must still be reviewed
candidates.notes: Cannot track daily equity valuation, risk appetite, or original 617-week SPX normalization; NOT an equivalent replacement.

candidates.provider: U.S. Treasury Office of Financial Research FSI
candidates.commercial_rights_evidence: Official OFR source index contains underlying VIX, DXY and Refinitiv/market-sourced inputs; downstream rights not cleared
candidates.notes: OFR index is not a clean escape from Cboe/ICE and Refinitiv permissions; methodology measures systemic stress, not VIX.

candidates.provider: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago NFCI
candidates.cadence: weekly Wednesday release for prior Friday, with revisions
candidates.commercial_rights_evidence: FRED page marks NFCI as copyrighted; reuse from original Chicago Fed needs source rights and embedded input review
candidates.notes: NFCI aggregates 105 financial indicators and can revise back history; do not treat it as government public domain.

candidates.provider: Internally calculated from rights-reviewed direct Treasury yields
candidates.cadence: derived from selected daily observations; release lag to be validated
candidates.commercial_rights_evidence: Requires direct Treasury source reuse/retention permission and a new methodology; cannot use FRED transport
candidates.notes: New rates-stress measure not a VIX parity substitution; may reuse rate drivers causing double-counting.

drivers.legacy_source: Yahoo Finance delivery; Bitcoin composite USD spot

candidates.cadence: near real time with plan-limited history
candidates.commercial_rights_evidence: CoinGecko explicitly says free/demo/keyless plans do not grant commercial rights; paid plan required
candidates.notes: Attribution alone does not cure absent commercial license; redistribution may require custom agreement.

candidates.provider: Coin Metrics Community API reference rates
candidates.cadence: Community reference-rate granularity/history limited; some last seven data points
candidates.commercial_rights_evidence: Official Coin Metrics documentation says free Community data for non-commercial use; license and history insufficient
candidates.notes: Free access does not establish commercial use or full 617-week history.

candidates.provider: Bitcoin protocol network metric (e.g., chain block count/difficulty), no intermediary BTC/USD price
candidates.cadence: network blocks continuously; reliable timestamp and cost/access design needed
candidates.commercial_rights_evidence: Raw blockchain provenance, node access, open-source software license and lawful reuse need independent assessment
candidates.notes: Potentially independently derived protocol data after assessment, but has no USD market valuation and requires different economic model.

drivers.legacy_source: Yahoo delivery; CME gold continuous front futures

candidates.provider: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries Gold data release
candidates.commercial_rights_evidence: 2026 USGS data release expressly marked CC0 1.0; verify specific gold table and underlying citations
candidates.notes: Annual price/mining/production context only; cannot support weekly continuous gold futures or original historic Score.

candidates.provider: World Bank Pink Sheet gold price
candidates.cadence: monthly/annual average; publication lag and revisions
candidates.commercial_rights_evidence: World Bank default CC BY 4.0 does not by itself prove all underlying benchmark/third-party gold market quotations are sublicensed
candidates.notes: Confirm precise dataset-specific license, LBMA/London underlying quotation rights and lag; monthly data cannot match weekly futures.

candidates.provider: U.S. Treasury daily nominal par yield curve BC_2YEAR
candidates.cadence: daily nominal par yields; Treasury says usually published by 18:00 America/New_York on each trading day (may be delayed); exact first-published timestamp unverified
candidates.commercial_rights_evidence: Official U.S. Treasury government-produced rates; exact commercial retention/public-derivative applicability and upstream input rights require sign-off
candidates.notes: Synthetic Atom/OData year/month parser exists; no live feed fetch/one-to-one H.15/FRED parity; no hidden FRED retransmission. Friday 22:00 UTC aligns with ~18:00 EDT and is not guaranteed to include the latest Friday observation.

candidates.provider: U.S. Treasury daily nominal par yield curve BC_10YEAR
candidates.cadence: daily nominal par yields; Treasury says usually published by 18:00 America/New_York on each trading day (may be delayed); exact first-published timestamp unverified
candidates.commercial_rights_evidence: Official U.S. Treasury government-produced rates; exact commercial retention/public-derivative applicability and upstream input rights require sign-off
candidates.notes: No assumption that a same-date Treasury observation equals an as-published FRED DGS10 vintage. Friday 22:00 UTC aligns with ~18:00 EDT and is not guaranteed to include the latest Friday observation.

alternative_design.name: Federal Public-Source Regime Study (internal working title only)
caveats: H.10 Monday previous-week publication precludes same-Friday full-week release
EIA WPSR Wednesday after preceding Friday, not same-Friday
Treasury XML 2Y/10Y requires rights, source transport and H.15 timing/parity confirmation
4-signal indicator is not ICE DXY/CME WTI/SPX/VIX/BTC/gold

release_lag_constraints.fed_h10_rule: previous business week daily observations are released Mondays about 16:15 America/New_York (holiday shifts)
release_lag_constraints.eia_wpsr_rule: last week's Friday-ending inventory is typically published following Wednesday 10:30 America/New_York (holiday shifts)
release_lag_constraints.eia_spot_rule: website example Oct 28 release contained obs through Oct 27; source assessment lag and weekly batching, not real-time future
release_lag_constraints.rule: a value is not eligible for any research publication until actual first_publication_at <= as_of_at and rights/approval gates independently pass
release_lag_constraints.treasury_rule: Treasury official daily nominal par yields usually published by 18:00 America/New_York on trading days (may be delayed); Friday 22:00 UTC approximately coincides with release in EDT, so no unconditional Friday visibility

explicit_no_go: Do not label Fed Broad USD Index ICE DXY, EIA spot as CME futures, government financial-stress indices VIX, or BEA profits S&P 500.
Do not treat EIA general public domain wording as grant covering Refinitiv WTI price series.
Do not count CoinGecko Demo or Coin Metrics Community as free commercial BTC price licenses.
Do not use OFR FSI to bypass embedded Cboe/ICE/Refinitiv data rights.
Do not use monthly World Bank or annual CC0 USGS Gold as weekly continuous front gold futures.
Do not use Treasury date as proof of first-publication availability or FRED as-of-vintage parity.
Do not compute/backfill/publish any new Score or material derivative while rights gate HOLD.
next_phase_authorization_required: Provider/counsel assessment for any market input whose original/underlying data come from third parties
Direct Treasury source-level rights and H.15 parity for 2Y/10Y
EIA assessment for surveyed stocks versus privately supplied WTI spot prices
Explicit owner approval of separately branded reduced/macro-score methodology
Synthetic-only timing/holiday/revision and consumer-contract tests, then separate data retrieval decision
Legal-safe legacy artifact preservation and public-retention remediation before any release
